details: Malicious package. A `preinstall` (and `preupdate`) script runs `node index.js`, which reads `/etc/passwd` (and attempts the Windows SAM hive and `C:\Users`), lists the current working directory, runs `id`/`whoami`, collects the user name, home directory, UID/GID and OS release, and posts it all to a hardcoded Discord webhook (1471187072869073017). The code labels its messages "Dependency Confusion Executed" and "Bug Bounty Execution", but it runs without consent on any machine that installs it. `index.js` (sha256 fb8451975ead2a956d3d8092eb2868d1ba9135fb6ef30e75941b1454958f75ae) is shared by `canvas_webgl_minimal` and `playwright-config`; the same webhook is used by `google-caja-bower` (MAL-2026-10186). Published 2026-02-23 and unpublished from npm on 2026-02-24.
